label: Vermietung
research: Airbnb host app (2025 rebuild: Today · Calendar · Listings · Messages; a reservation opens on its state: guest, dates, payout, with the next action – accept a request, message – on top; the calendar is per listing with a multi-listing view), Booking.com extranet (reservations list filtered by arrival/stay/departure + a calendar per room type), Lodgify/Smoobu (one multi-calendar with a row per unit, booking detail as a page with guest, dates, price, deposit), Skedda/Robin (spaces as a list + a day/week grid per space; empty slot = book), long-term property management (Buildium, Hausify/objego): a lease page shows term, rent, deposit, tenants and key dates (start, notice deadline, end) with 'Kündigung erfassen' as an action, documents next to it. Empty states offer the one action (Add listing / Add unit). Taken: objects as the area home (what's free / with whom), Vergaben as the list with a Kalender view switch (Belegung), the rental page on its state (Stats: Laufzeit/Frist/Miete/Kaution; next step as primary: Bestätigen, Kündigung eintragen, Zurücknehmen), properties edited in place, people + keys as main lists, status changes as actions with confirmation; object page per patterns.md §8.
